title: Exclude fixed-literal QUERY and idle bundles on #7830
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

All 8 BIT pairs and 112 rational A QUERY/IDLE_ONE pairs require transfer rank above one in the stated fixed-literal single-owner-field repair. Each control checks both the block exit and complete literal caller. A distinct six-plus-one BIT factor test prices favorably before repair, but exact minors reject all eight pairs across the stated finite-ring specializations.

## Task and overlap

Scoped #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212` on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. #7830 head `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15` supplies both callers. #7111 reports earlier fixed-mask and native-return screens. The changed-input domain here is literal same-block QUERY plus idle with a fixed correction interface.

## Validation

A clean copy passed `python3 -I -B replay.py` in 10.84 s, with exact main and independent control receipts. Independent column replays detect the nonzero minors. The two-field alternative is restricted to the explicit D=UV factor and one rank-one second field. Other independently addressable fields and changed literals remain open.

## Credit

Credit the #7830 and underlying #7776 signed caller contributors. Clear1nsight prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next questions

Seek an exact two-direction repair at an existing paid site and account for all intervening reads.
